key_impacts: Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
Two refineries in New Jersey (Hess Port Reading and Phillips 66 Bayway in Linden) were shut down, resulting in the loss of 26.3% of the total operating capacity of 1,170,200 barrels per day.
In New York City, storm-surge flooding exceeded the 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to the outage.
Sandy caused more than 200 fatalities along its track.
